# agyn_image (Resource)

Manages an image in the Agyn catalog. Versions are discovered from the upstream repository and cannot be declared.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# An image is registered once; its versions are discovered from the upstream
# repository, so there is nothing to declare per release.
resource "agyn_image" "devcontainer" {
  organization_id = var.organization_id
  name            = "devcontainer-go"
  description     = "Go devcontainer"
  type            = "workspace"
  repository      = "ghcr.io/agynio/devcontainer-go"
  visibility      = "internal"
}

# A private repository names a credential by reference, so the password lives
# in a secret rather than in this configuration or in the state file.
resource "agyn_secret" "registry" {
  organization_id = var.organization_id
  name            = "internal-tools-registry"
  value           = var.registry_password
}

resource "agyn_image" "private" {
  organization_id = var.organization_id
  name            = "internal-tools"
  type            = "mcp"
  repository      = "ghcr.io/acme/internal-tools"
  username        = "robot"
  secret_id       = agyn_secret.registry.id
  visibility      = "internal"
  tag_filter      = "v*"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Image name, unique within the organization. Matches `^[a-z0-9-]+$`.
- `organization_id` (String) Organization that owns the image.
- `repository` (String) Upstream repository, e.g. `ghcr.io/agynio/devcontainer-go`. Must not carry a tag or digest. Immutable.
- `type` (String) Which slot the image is built for: `workspace`, `agent_runtime`, or `mcp`. Immutable.
- `visibility` (String) `public` (usable by every organization) or `internal` (the owning organization only).

### Optional

- `description` (String) Free text shown beside the name.
- `secret_id` (String) UUID of the Secret holding the registry password. Must belong to the same organization. Omit for an anonymously readable repository.
- `tag_filter` (String) Optional glob limiting which tags appear in pickers.
- `username` (String) Registry username. Omit for an anonymously readable repository.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID identifier of the image.
